title: Ben Rich says the math in Maxwell's equations is a little off

tellings.quote: even going back to the '9s, Ben Rich saying there was some math in Maxwell's equations that was a little off.

plain: In the 1990s Ben Rich, a former head of Lockheed's Skunk Works, the company's secret aircraft division, said that some of the math in Maxwell's equations, the 1800s equations of electricity and magnetism, was a little off. Michels mentions it himself, without a source, as an early hint that insiders thought known physics was incomplete.
